args.query: read a GRIB2 weather forecast with xarray and cfgrib and extract 2m temperature at a lat lon

results.title: tar pack, list and extract
results.summary: Create a gzipped tarball from a temp directory tree with node-tar, list entries, then extract a filtered subtree with strip and assert contents offline.

results.title: pandas to_sql and read_sql with a SQLAlchemy 2 engine on sqlite, with dtype handling
results.summary: Write and read DataFrames through a SQLAlchemy 2 engine, control column types with dtype, and handle datetimes and nullable ints, tested offline on in-memory sqlite.

results.title: pandas DataFrame to formatted Excel report with openpyxl styles and roundtrip read
results.summary: Write a DataFrame to a styled .xlsx with openpyxl (header styles, number formats, widths, freeze panes, filters), then read it back with pandas and verify, fully offline.

results.title: Ajv standalone validation code generated at build time
results.summary: Compile JSON Schemas once with Ajv into standalone ESM validator modules, write them to disk and import them at runtime without compiling, checking errors, defaults and type coercion.

results.title: Excel .xlsx export and import with ExcelJS
results.summary: Generate styled .xlsx reports (header row, number formats, formulas, frozen panes) and read uploaded workbooks back into typed rows with ExcelJS, all in memory.

results.title: polib PO catalog read, edit and write roundtrip with MO compile
results.summary: Read, edit and write gettext PO catalogs with polib, compile them to MO, and audit fuzzy and untranslated entries fully offline.

results.title: chrono-node natural language dates with a fixed reference and timezone
results.summary: Parse phrases like "tomorrow at 9am", weekday names, ranges and dates inside sentences with chrono-node against a fixed reference instant and UTC offset, plus en.GB day-first parsing.

results.title: pyotp TOTP and HOTP codes tested at frozen time
results.summary: Generate RFC-compatible TOTP and HOTP codes, build otpauth provisioning URIs and tolerate one-step clock drift, all pinned to deterministic time with freezegun.

results.title: Markdown to HTML with fenced code, codehilite, toc and tables
results.summary: Render Markdown with Python-Markdown extensions and Pygments highlighting, extract a nested table of contents, and generate the matching Pygments CSS.

results.title: pdf-lib create and read invoice PDF
results.summary: Build a multi-page invoice PDF with pdf-lib, draw text and rectangles, then reload the bytes and assert page count offline.
